facilities.source: https://doddridgecountypark.com/camp/ ('a camp store and gift shop ... and men's and women's restroom and shower facilities'; 'Campground dumpsters and a dump station are also available. WIFI is available thru the first ten slips'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 'Reserve Now!' on the park page goes to Campspot. The 14-consecutive-day limit applies to stays between April 15 and October 31. Holiday or special-event weekends 'may require 3 day minimum reservations (Check w/ your Camping Specialist)'. Refunds: 100% 30+ days out, 50% within 29 days.

booking.source: https://doddridgecountypark.com/camp/ + DCPCampground-Brochure.pdf ('Camping stay is limited to fourteen (14) consecutive days if your reservation falls anywhere between April 15th and October 31st.'; 'Holiday or Special Event Weekends may require 3 day minimum reservations'; '30+ days out = 100% refund, 29 days and under = 50% refund'), read 2026-10-21

note: Doddridge County Park's campground near West Union, an access point to the North Bend Rail Trail, with tent sites and three yurts beside its RV slips. The park borders Meathouse Fork, but the creekside sites are the wooded tent sites, and the RV slips sit back from the creek. The camp office has a covered deck with a fireplace and television, and the park has a pool from late May to early September, trails, playgrounds and courts. --Claude
summary: Park page + rules brochure: confirmed 50-amp/water/sewer, Campspot booking, dump/Wi-Fi/store; added 24 slips with pull-throughs, showers, 14-night max (Apr 15-Oct 31) and the possible 3-night holiday minimum (note only). Fees left as read on Campspot 2026-10-13 ($37.74-44.34). Note trimmed of slip counts, sewer, store and Wi-Fi facts now held in fields.
